描述_EN: indeed the 'hufu' became the fashion in the 7th and early 8th century. it consisted of a tunic, loose trousers and high boots. like the men, the women also adopted the so-called 'foreigners’ dress' (‘hufu’) of their horse-riding neighbours. both men and women dressed in 'hufu' could be seen in the streets of the capital city chang'an. during the tang dynasty (618-907) both the men and women of the chinese aristocracy took to horse-riding.
描述_ZN: 事实上，"胡服 "在7世纪和8世纪初成为了一种时尚。 它包括一件外衣，宽松的裤子和高筒靴。 与男性一样，女性也采用了他们骑马的邻居的所谓 "洋人的衣服"（'胡服'）。 在首都长安的街道上可以看到穿着 "胡服 "的男女。 在唐朝（618-907），中国贵族的男人和女人都喜欢骑马。
